name: Matron
ability: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.
setup: Traveller: joins with an alignment chosen by the Storyteller; does not change the base character counts.
interaction: During the day the Matron declares up to three pairs to swap seats, one after another; the Storyteller swaps their tokens and reminders in the Grimoire.

rulings.text: The new seating persists; a player can be moved more than once.
Players who cannot easily move are immune.
Private conversation is only allowed between neighbours.
Swaps happen one after the other; after stopping at one or two, no more that day.

test_scenarios.name: swap changes neighbours
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Alice Matron, Bob Tea Lady, Carol Chef, Dave Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice swaps Carol and Dave.
test_scenarios.expected: Dave now neighbours Bob; Tea Lady neighbour checks use the new seating.

test_scenarios.name: three swaps max
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice makes three swaps then asks for a fourth.

test_scenarios.name: no resuming
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: one swap, then discussion, then another swap request.

test_scenarios.name: affects Empath
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Bob Empath between Carol Chef and Eve Chef; Dave Imp elsewhere.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Matron swaps Carol and Dave. Night 2: Bob wakes.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob's number counts Dave as a neighbour.
